name: SpeTool 1/8" up-cut 2FL, 1/4" shank
sku: SpeTool SP-1/8 Dia 1/4 shank, SPE-X coating (Amazon B0BN5PGTCY)
notes: The 1/8" cutter for the 1/4" collet: 1/2" cutting length, 2" OAL, up-cut. Numbered 102 after Carbide 3D's convention for a 1/8" 2-flute square endmill so Carbide Motion names it in the prompt. Does the crystal A F125 op (windows, square edges, rabbets) in place of the #274-Z.

name: #201 1/4" square 3FL
notes: 1/4" shank, .75" LOC, 2.5" OAL. General purpose wood/plastic.

name: Eanosic E221 90° V-bit
notes: Arrived 11-05. Bought as the spare V-bit. Cutting diameter, shank and flutes are ASSUMED, not measured: measure before relying on it for anything but spot marks.

name: E253 1/16" ball nose
notes: 1/4" shank, 1/16" ball, 1" cut length, 2" OAL. Long thin reach: keep stepovers and feeds gentle.

name: #274-Z 1/8" single flute ZrN
notes: 1/8" shank, .500" LOC, 1.5" OAL. Single flute for aluminium and plastics. Runs in the 1/8" ER20 collet.

name: #278-Z 1/4" single flute ZrN
notes: 1/4" shank, .75" LOC, 2.25" OAL. Single flute O-style for aluminium and plastics. Default feed lowered to the aluminium starting point (18000 rpm, 900 mm/min, plunge 250; untested as of 2026-11-05). Only one on hand, so protect it.

name: E287 1/8" ball nose
notes: 1/4" shank, 1/8" ball (R 1/16), 1" cut length, 2.5" OAL. Long reach for 3D finishing.

name: BINSTAK 90° V-groove 1/2"
notes: Carbide-tipped 90° V, 1/4" shank, marked S1/4-V90. The crystal A package calls it V90 (labels 0.3 deep). Cutting diameter measured 12.84 mm (2026-11-05).

name: Amana 46369-K 1/8" ball nose Spektra
notes: Up-cut ball nose, R 1/16, 1/2" cutting height, 1/4" shank, 2" OAL, nACo (Spektra) coated.

name: Amana 46373-K 1/16" ball nose Spektra
notes: Up-cut ball nose, R 1/32, 1/4" cutting height, 1/8" shank, 2" OAL, nACo (Spektra) coated. Amana recommends 20-21k rpm. Runs in the 1/8" ER20 collet.

name: M.A. Ford 1/32" PCB drill
notes: 1/32" x .400" flute x 1-1/2" OAL, 1/8" shank, 130° point, uncoated carbide. Peck drill only. Runs in the 1/8" ER20 collet.

name: Cobalt 2.5 mm drill, M35
notes: Arrived 11-07. Flute and overall length not measured. Point angle 135 ASSUMED. 8000 rpm and 300 mm/min are copied from the 3.3 drill and untested at this size: scrap test first. For M3 tap holes.

name: Cobalt 3.3 mm drill, M35
notes: Arrived 11-05. Fits Harvey's 1/8" ER20 collet snugly (Harvey, 11-06), Don drilled test holes 11-06 at 400 mm/min: drilled well, felt a little fast, so default is 300. Flute length, overall length and point angle are ASSUMED typical jobber sizes: measure. For M4 tap holes.

name: Cobalt 4.2 mm drill, M35
notes: Arrived 11-07. Overall length 74.16 measured by Harvey 11-07; flute length not measured. Point angle 135 ASSUMED. 8000 rpm and 300 mm/min are copied from the 3.3 drill and untested at this size: scrap test first. For M5 tap holes.

name: Cobalt 4.5 mm drill, M35
notes: Arrived 11-07. Flute and overall length not measured. Point angle 135 ASSUMED. 8000 rpm and 300 mm/min are copied from the 3.3 drill and untested at this size: scrap test first. For M4 clearance holes.

name: Cobalt 5.0 mm drill, M35
notes: Arrived 11-07. Flute and overall length not measured. Point angle 135 ASSUMED. 8000 rpm and 300 mm/min are copied from the 3.3 drill and untested at this size: scrap test first. For M6 tap holes and clearance.

name: 4 mm single flute (box of 10)
notes: 4 mm shank (measured 3.98), 22 mm cut length, 45 mm OAL. Unbranded set of 10, grade and coating unknown: treat as expendable, try on scrap before aluminium. No 4 mm collet on hand, so it cannot run yet.

name: BB 10 mm single flute
notes: 10 mm shank, 32 mm cut length, 75 mm OAL. Micro-grain carbide single flute for aluminium/plastic. No 10 mm collet on hand (ER20 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 only), so it cannot run yet.

name: Dreanique 1 mm single flute DLC
notes: DLC coated, 4 mm cut length. Fragile: shallow passes (0.3-0.5 mm) and gentle plunges. Measured 2026-11-05: shank 3.16 mm, OAL 38.31. Runs in the 1/8" ER20 collet.

name: Dreanique 2 mm single flute DLC
notes: DLC coated, 8 mm cut length. Measured 2026-11-05: shank 3.16 mm, OAL 38.51. Runs in the 1/8" ER20 collet.

name: Dreanique 4 mm single flute DLC
notes: DLC coated, 22 mm cut length. The good 4 mm single flute for aluminium. Measured 2026-11-05: shank 3.16 mm (narrower than the 4 mm cutter), OAL 50.26. Runs in the 1/8" ER20 collet; the thin shank limits how hard it can be pushed.

name: WEXWE 1/4" single flute ZrN
notes: 2 ordered 11-05, arrived 11-07, spare for the #278-Z. Sizes are from the listing, not measured. Listing's spec table says 2" cutting length; its bullets say 3/4". Coating listed as both ZrN and DLC. Measure on arrival, check the tip, and try on scrap before real parts.
